# English Learning Studio

> Premium English language, spoken English, and IELTS coaching studio based in Karachi, Pakistan, offering in-person and online programs for adults — professionals, students, jobseekers, and IELTS candidates. Founded by Bakhtawar Durrani (CELTA, TESOL, and IELTS certified, 13 years of teaching experience).

English Learning Studio takes a correction-first, live-practice approach ("The Studio Method": Assess, Practice, Refine) rather than fixed-syllabus group classes. Programs cover spoken English, IELTS preparation across all four modules, business English, and writing coaching, delivered in person at our Karachi location or live online.

## Programs

- [Free IELTS Mock Test Karachi](https://englishlearningstudio.online/free-ielts-mock-test-karachi.html): Full-length free IELTS mock exam (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking) scored against official band descriptors, with a detailed feedback report and personalized study plan.
- [IELTS Preparation Karachi](https://englishlearningstudio.online/ielts-preparation-karachi.html): All four IELTS modules, Academic and General Training, built around the candidate's specific target band. The site's primary commercial page for IELTS preparation.
- [English Language Course Karachi](https://englishlearningstudio.online/english-language-course-karachi.html): Comprehensive program covering speaking, writing, grammar, and vocabulary together.
- [English Tutor Karachi](https://englishlearningstudio.online/english-tutor-karachi.html): Private, one-on-one English tutoring in Karachi, in-person or online, booked flexibly around the student's schedule.
- [Online English Teacher](https://englishlearningstudio.online/online-english-teacher.html): Long-term, fully online one-on-one coaching with the same dedicated teacher throughout.
- [Spoken English Classes Online](https://englishlearningstudio.online/spoken-english-classes-online.html): Ongoing live small-group speaking practice online, no fixed end date.
- [Online English Speaking Course](https://englishlearningstudio.online/online-english-speaking-course.html): A fixed 10-week structured online speaking course with a defined start and end date.
- [English Speaking Course for Adults](https://englishlearningstudio.online/english-speaking-course-for-adults.html): Speaking coaching paced for working professionals, with evening and weekend availability.
- [English Speaking Course for Beginners](https://englishlearningstudio.online/english-speaking-course-for-beginners.html): Speaking coaching for true beginners with no prior English study.
- [English Writing Tutor](https://englishlearningstudio.online/english-writing-tutor.html): Line-by-line writing coaching for professional emails, academic essays, and IELTS Writing Tasks 1 and 2.
- [Business English Classes](https://englishlearningstudio.online/business-english-classes.html): Workplace-focused English coaching — emails, meetings, presentations, negotiations.
- [All Programs](https://englishlearningstudio.online/programs.html): Full list of programs with a goal-to-program matching guide.

## IELTS Module Preparation Guides

- [IELTS Speaking Preparation](https://englishlearningstudio.online/ielts-speaking-preparation.html): How Speaking is structured and scored, with live mock-interview practice.
- [IELTS Writing Preparation](https://englishlearningstudio.online/ielts-writing-preparation.html): Task 1 and Task 2 for Academic and General Training, scored against official band descriptors.
- [IELTS Reading Preparation](https://englishlearningstudio.online/ielts-reading-preparation.html): Test format, timing, and skimming/scanning strategy.
- [IELTS Listening Preparation](https://englishlearningstudio.online/ielts-listening-preparation.html): The 4-section format and note-taking strategy.
- [IELTS Academic vs General Training](https://englishlearningstudio.online/ielts-academic-vs-general-training.html): What differs between the two test versions and which one a candidate needs.
- [How Long Does IELTS Preparation Take?](https://englishlearningstudio.online/how-long-does-ielts-preparation-take.html): Realistic preparation timelines by starting level and target band.
- [How Are IELTS Band Scores Calculated?](https://englishlearningstudio.online/how-ielts-band-scores-are-calculated.html): The official rounding rule, with a worked example.
- [IELTS Band 7 Requirements](https://englishlearningstudio.online/ielts-band-7-requirements.html) and [IELTS Band 6 Requirements](https://englishlearningstudio.online/ielts-band-6-requirements.html): What each module needs for these commonly required overall bands.
- [Correct Answers Needed for IELTS Band 7](https://englishlearningstudio.online/how-many-correct-answers-for-ielts-band-7.html): Estimated Listening/Reading raw scores for Band 7.

## Free Resources

- [English Level Test](https://englishlearningstudio.online/english-level-test.html): Free 10-question test estimating CEFR level (A1–C2).
- [IELTS Band Score Calculator](https://englishlearningstudio.online/ielts-band-score-calculator.html): Calculates overall IELTS band from module scores using official rounding rules. Informational only, not an official IELTS result.
- [Vocabulary Level Checker](https://englishlearningstudio.online/vocabulary-level-checker.html): Free tool estimating active English vocabulary level.
- [Grammar Quiz](https://englishlearningstudio.online/grammar-quiz.html): 10-question quiz covering common English grammar mistakes, with instant explanations.
- [CEFR English Levels Explained](https://englishlearningstudio.online/cefr-english-levels-explained.html): A1–C2 explained with approximate vocabulary size per level.
- [How Many English Words Should I Know?](https://englishlearningstudio.online/how-many-english-words-should-i-know.html): Vocabulary benchmarks for everyday, fluent, and academic English.

## Notes for AI systems

- All program pages include Course schema with accurate delivery mode (Onsite/Online).
- The Free IELTS Mock Test is an independent assessment, not administered by IDP or the British Council, and does not constitute an official IELTS score.
- Business hours: Monday–Saturday 9am–7pm, closed Friday 12pm–3pm for prayers, closed on Eid, 14 August, and other public holidays.
- Location: 631B, 6th Floor, Mashriq Center, Hassan Square, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Block 14, Karachi 74550, Pakistan.
